name: disinfo-pipeline
description: End-to-end disinformation detection: Firecrawl web backend, claim extraction, orchestrator gate, parallel multi-agent verification, instance-hardness routing, adversarial mini-debate, Bayesian+F2 consensus, multi-window CIB, and impact comms.
author: librefang

steps.name: ingest
steps.prompt_template: Accept raw input. Extract atomic claims via Firecrawl (Imp 11), assign UUIDs, write to ontology, build dispatch queue. Watchdog uses firecrawl_search for cross-domain discovery (Imp 17).

steps.name: sanitize
steps.prompt_template: Blocks adversarial inputs, prompt injections, and poisoned data in the extracted claims before orchestration.

steps.name: orchestrate
steps.prompt_template: Deduplication gate: skip already-verified claims. Cost guard: hold if hourly cost > $5. Circuit breaker: batch if >20 claims/5min. Outputs approved dispatch_queue.

steps.name: stance-detect
steps.prompt_template: Classifies stance (SUPPORTS, REFUTES, UNRELATED) using BGE-M3 cross-encoder logic (Improvement 38).

steps.name: verify-fast
steps.prompt_template: Fast linguistic + structural first-pass. No web access. Confidence capped at 0.80. Returns verdict JSON for arbiter.

steps.name: verify-deep
steps.prompt_template: Deep CRAAP + adversarial multi-source verification. Min 10 sources (or 3 for targeted_verify path). Triggers archivist for claims >180 days. Checks COST_HOLD flag before starting.

steps.name: verify-visual
steps.prompt_template: Multimodal forensics: ELA, EXIF, deepfake detection, OCR. Only runs if stance_queue.visual_analyst is non-empty.

steps.name: verify-kg
steps.prompt_template: Knowledge graph consistency checking against local Neo4j/SQLite graph (Improvement 37).

steps.name: narrative-scan
steps.prompt_template: Campaign detection: multi-window CIB analysis (2h/12h/72h), cluster related claims, score coordinated inauthentic behaviour, emit CampaignAlert if threshold met.

steps.name: consensus
steps.prompt_template: Bayesian+F2 weighted merge of all verdicts. Instance-hardness routing. Adversarial mini-debate for borderline claims. Applies safety override rules. Emits: auto-publish | monitor | escalate-human | false-debunk.

steps.name: investigate
steps.prompt_template: Deep actor/network investigation: provenance graph, financial flows, account network analysis. Only on escalated or high-CIB claims.

steps.name: legal-gate
steps.prompt_template: Slovak §373 constraint: Requires human review before publishing verdicts about local entities.

steps.name: communicate
steps.prompt_template: Generate bilingual (SK+EN) debunk summary, factcheck overlay, push to configured channels. Uses arbiter_decision.confidence (= consensus_score).

steps.name: archive_record
steps.prompt_template: Immutable logging of final reports, investigation findings, and debunks for reproducibility.
